name: forward-normal-render-pass
purpose: Verify Eevee forward and blended surface materials write usable Normal render-pass data for viewport/pass preview and outline normal-edge detection.
passCriteria: A BLENDED material on a tilted plane must produce a non-black Normal render pass in Eevee, and the sampled normal vector must differ from the black background by a clear margin. Generated EXR and summary.json are written under this case's out directory.
